diagnosis.root_cause: The payment service failed during execution of the 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' gRPC method, returning error 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold'. This failure caused upstream caller checkout service's 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' RPC to fail with gRPC code 13 INTERNAL ('could not charge the card'), which in turn caused frontend request failures. This issue directly correlates with the active dynamic chaos flag 'paymentFailure' set to variant '50%', causing simulated token validation rejections.

evidence.log_excerpt: Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold

remediation_plan.summary: Disable the 'paymentFailure' feature flag to restore payment processing functionality.

actions.description: Disable the paymentFailure chaos flag in Feature Flag service.
Verify error rate drops to 0% in Prometheus.
